objective.statement: Make the Codex turn-boundary hook consume coordination mail reliably without sharing the interactive reader session.
objective.measure: Unit and transport tests use the isolated hook session; a rejected stored capability is replaced after one bounded retry.

need.statement: The installed hook still uses the superseded root session and a rejected stored capability can poison later sweeps.
need.baseline: Live sweeps report a foreign-principal rejection for codex-01a0b352-root; the transport contract still expects root while canonical source uses hook.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Every turn emits a mailbox failure and coordination messages are not consumed.
assumptions: The documented principal-lane session form supports a stable hook suffix.
alternatives_considered: Use an isolated hook session and renew rejected local capability

admission.reason: Operator-directed repair; trusted admission receipt unavailable.

purpose: Restore reliable Codex coordination sweeps while keeping the hook reader isolated from the interactive reader.
consumer: Codex SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks and operators relying on repo_memory delivery.
contract: Every turn-boundary hook shall use `${principal}-hook`; when a persisted inbox capability is rejected for ownership, subscribe shall retry once without it and persist the replacement.
failure_boundary: The hook remains fail-open, never logs the signed capability, never mutates foreign server-side inbox state, and performs at most one capability retry.

evidence.description: Unit tests prove hook-session isolation and one bounded stale-capability retry.
Transport test proves the wire session is principal-hook.
After Home Manager activation, the next live hook sweep no longer reports the root-session rejection.

falsifier.claim: Codex hook coordination is isolated and self-healing.

executable_check.description: Any root-session assertion or rejected-capability retry failure falsifies the contract.

invariants: principal remains derived from the Codex thread identity

assumptions.statement: The server accepts a principal-hook session for the same principal.
assumptions.falsifier: A live post-activation sweep rejects principal-hook without a persisted capability.

plane_constraints: Home Manager owns deployment; repo-memory owns authorization.
